method: 逐一查看随用户提供PDF提取的原卷图片，确认文字与空位；本文件不根据答案反推修改题干。

fixes.field: questionText paragraphs and corresponding intro/items strings
fixes.before: 35 Numerous training sessions are aimed at people who feel they are not enough.
fixes.after: 35 Numerous training sessions are aimed at people who feel they are not ______ enough.
fixes.reason: 原卷在not和enough之间有答案横线，OCR漏掉空位会使答题框被错误追加到句末。

fixes.before: With every bit of wilderness that disappears, we deprive ourselves of potential medicines.
fixes.after: I With every bit of wilderness that disappears, we deprive ourselves of potential medicines.
fixes.reason: 原卷末段左侧明确标注I。只补段落标签，保持该段索引及所有正文文字不变。

fixes.field: questionText paragraphs and corresponding intro/items strings
fixes.before: Studies by Ziming Liu show that students are tending to .ead .............. words and phrases
fixes.after: Studies by Ziming Liu show that students are tending to read 21 ______ words and phrases
fixes.reason: 原卷明确为read，之后是21号题空位，再接words and phrases；恢复漏掉的首字母与题号。

invariants: reading段落数量、次序和原索引保持不变
已有questionText.items或intro里的同一文字同步修复
重复应用不产生重复题号、段号或额外空位
本脚本不修改答案、题型、题号范围或原文证据字符串
